import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
try:
    sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
except FileNotFoundError:
    print('FILE_NOT_FOUND')
    raise SystemExit

    print(f'=== Sheet: {name} ===')
    print(f'Shape: {df.shape}')
    print(df.to_string())
    print()

from openpyxl import load_workbook

wb = load_workbook('budget.xlsx', data_only=True)
for name in wb.sheetnames:
    ws = wb[name]
    print(f'=== Sheet: {name} ===')
    print(f'Dimensions: {ws.dimensions}, max_row={ws.max_row}, max_col={ws.max_column}')
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        print([c.value for c in row])
    print()

import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {
    'main': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
    'rel': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships',
    'pkgrel': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships',
}

def col_letter_to_idx(ref):
    m = re.match(r'([A-Z]+)(\d+)', ref)
    letters = m.group(1)
    idx = 0
    for ch in letters:
        idx = idx * 26 + (ord(ch) - 64)
    return idx

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print('ZIP contents:')
    for n in names:
        print(' ', n)
    print()

    # shared strings
    shared = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in root.findall('main:si', NS):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared.append(text)
    print('Shared strings:', shared)
    print()

    # workbook sheet list
    wbroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    for sheet in wbroot.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheet'):
        print('Sheet:', sheet.get('name'), 'rid:', sheet.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id'))
    print()

    # map rIds to sheet xml
    relroot = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rid_map = {}
    for rel in relroot:
        rid_map[rel.get('Id')] = rel.get('Target')
    print('rels:', rid_map)
    print()

    for sheet in wbroot.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}sheet'):
        name = sheet.get('name')
        rid = sheet.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')
        target = rid_map[rid]
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        print(f'=== Sheet: {name} ({target}) ===')
        sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read(target))
        for row in sroot.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            cells = {}
            for c in row.findall('main:c', NS):
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('main:v', NS)
                val = v.text if v is not None else None
                if t == 's' and val is not None:
                    val = shared[int(val)]
                elif val is not None:
                    try:
                        val = float(val)
                        if val.is_integer():
                            val = int(val)
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
                cells[ref] = val
            print(cells)
        print()

import pandas as pd

path = 'budget.xlsx'
sheets = pd.read_excel(path, sheet_name=None, header=None)
print('SHEET NAMES:', list(sheets.keys()))
grand = 0.0
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f'\n=== Sheet: {name} ===')
    print(df.to_string())
    cleaned = df.applymap(lambda v: str(v).replace(',', '').replace('$', '') if isinstance(v, str) else v)
    nums = pd.to_numeric(cleaned.stack(), errors='coerce')
    total = float(nums.sum())
    print(f'--- Sum of numeric cells in "{name}": {total}')
    grand += total
print(f'\nGRAND TOTAL OF ALL NUMERIC CELLS: {grand}')
